meta_description:
1M likes, 6,151 comments - jrntr on August 18, 2026: "Bagheera, 
You came into my world as a companion and quietly became family — filling days with love, loyalty, mischief and a kind of comfort only you could give. Your absence leaves a silence that feels far too large, but so does the love you leave behind.

Thank you for choosing me, for walking beside me, and for making these four years infinitely more beautiful.

Run free, my little one. You were deeply loved, and you always will be. 🐾🤍".
